core_question: Can the scene be funny, visual, and ordinary without becoming a relationship lesson?
what_works: The idea has an instantly recognizable human contradiction.
The visual mismatch between thought bubble and facial reaction is clear without heavy text.
The doorway arrival gives a cinematic fourth-slide turn.
The shout can be one clean speech bubble instead of a narrated punchline.

risks.repair: Build storyboard panels first. Copy is only hook, thought bubble, and shout.
Keep her expressive but not cruel. Show this as emotional timing, not personality defect.
He does not fix, counsel, or rescue. He enters, freezes, and reacts like a normal human.
Use distinct cuts: wide, hand close-up, face close-up, doorway depth, full reaction, aftermath freeze.
